title: Enlarge the finite-type locus of a global module by one affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $W\subseteq X$ be a quasi-compact open [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], and let $V\subseteq X$ be an affine open. Let $\mathcal H$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, pqf-def-coherent] such that $\mathcal H|_W$ is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation]. Then there exists a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal E$ with a monomorphism $j:\mathcal E\to\mathcal H$ such that $\mathcal E|_{W\cup V}$ is of finite type and $j|_W$ is an isomorphism. No quasi-compactness of $X$ or finite type of $\mathcal E$ outside $W\cup V$ is required.

proof.text: The overlap W intersect V is quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness and compactness of affine opens. Identify H restricted to V with the tilde of its global sections N. Cover the overlap by finitely many principal affine opens D(f_i), on each of which N localized at f_i is finitely generated.

proof.text: Take the finitely generated submodule N-prime of N spanned by the numerators of those localized generators. Its tilde is quasi-coherent and finite type. The localized inclusion is surjective because it contains each chosen generator, and injective by localization of a submodule. Thus the associated sheaf inclusion is an isomorphism on every D(f_i), and hence on the overlap by the sheaf property.

proof.text: Glue this submodule on V with H restricted to W. On an open T of W union V, impose membership in both submodules after restriction to the two intersections. The equal overlap restrictions make this a subsheaf with the prescribed restrictions. Quasi-coherence and finite type are local.

proof.text: The union W union V is quasi-compact. Its inclusion into the quasi-separated scheme X is quasi-compact. Apply the quasi-coherent extension theorem to the glued submodule and its map into H restricted to the union. Take the image of the extended map in H. It is quasi-coherent and its monomorphic inclusion restricts to the glued submodule since open restriction is exact and the prescribed inclusion is monic. Consequently it is finite type on the union and restricts isomorphically to H on W.

theorem exists_finiteType_affine_enlargement
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (W : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (V : X.affineOpens)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) [H.IsQuasicoherent]
    [(H.over W).IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ (E : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)), E.IsQuasicoherent ∧
      (E.over (W ⊔ V.1)).IsFiniteType ∧ ∃ (j : E ⟶ H),
        Mono j ∧ IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor
          (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) W).map j)
